english.title: Possess / control TV set with intent another use install without a licence
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were in possession or control of a

(A)_[colour]_
(B)_[black and white]_

television receiver, knowing or having reasonable grounds for believing that another person intended to install or use the receiver without a licence
english.legislation: Contrary to section 363(3)(b) and (4) of the Communications Act 2003.
